frustrations.cause: Full-range positions only (Q-017, DEP-007 NotFullRange)
frustrations.fix: Explain before the NFT approval, show the fee-yield difference, offer a one-click convert; concentrated ranges are a later expansion
frustrations.say: My concentrated-range position was rejected; full range earns far less in fees.

frustrations.cause: LP CF = min(CF0, CF1) x poolRiskFactor (~25-31%) and then minOpeningHealthFactor 1.10 on top (Q-018)
frustrations.fix: Show the effective borrow limit before pledging; raise poolRiskFactor for the deepest pools after a track record
frustrations.say: I can only borrow about $28 per $100 of LP.

frustrations.cause: marketUsdCap per market (1.5, Q-055); caps fill on a first-come basis and a debt-free pledger keeps its cap room while earning fees
frustrations.fix: Show remaining cap room and a queue/notify-when-room; publish cap-raise plans; consider a per-wallet share of new cap room
frustrations.say: The market is full, so I can't pledge.

frustrations.cause: Fees always go to the depositor (Q-105); no collect-and-repay
frustrations.fix: Batch collect + swap + repay (EIP-5792 batch in the app, or an Adapter helper)
frustrations.say: I collect fees and then repay by hand; it should be one step.

frustrations.cause: minPledgeUsd $10 is far below the mainnet gas cost of approve + pledge + borrow (~$30-80)
frustrations.fix: Raise minPledgeUsd to a gas-aware level (e.g. $500-1,000) or show a break-even warning
frustrations.say: The gas to pledge and borrow cost more than I can borrow.

frustrations.cause: Withdrawal returns one whole NFT; units must equal credited units (WDR-014); no partial decrease while pledged
frustrations.fix: Add a partial-decrease path that removes liquidity from a pledged NFT subject to the same HF checks
frustrations.say: To take out part of my liquidity I have to repay and withdraw the whole NFT.

frustrations.cause: Every collateral input must be Live and within borrowPriceMaxAge (1 h) at the block (BOR-006); heartbeat = max age leaves windows each hour
frustrations.fix: Set borrowPriceMaxAge >= heartbeat + margin; app explains the state and when it clears
frustrations.say: Borrow is blocked even though prices look normal.

frustrations.cause: GHO credit line 2,000,000 (Q-006) / Hub drawCap
frustrations.fix: Show remaining credit line; raise with demand
frustrations.say: Borrowing is unavailable: the credit line is used up.

frustrations.fix: Alerts, previews of liquidation price, rescue paths
frustrations.say: I was liquidated.

frustrations.cause: No repay-with-collateral / self-deleverage path; withdraw-with-debt needs HF >= 1.10 after
frustrations.fix: Add a self-deleverage call that unwinds part of the pledged liquidity to repay (reusing LPVaultSwap routes, no bonus)
frustrations.say: I have to find outside GHO/USDC to close; I cannot repay with my collateral.

frustrations.cause: NFPM.increaseLiquidity on a pledged NFT is a donation; credit is read only at pledge (DEP-009, Q-134)
frustrations.fix: Add a re-credit (top-up of an existing record) path or warn in the app and integrations
frustrations.say: I added liquidity to my pledged position but my health factor did not change.

frustrations.cause: Deadline checked on every call (DEP-002, BOR-003)
frustrations.fix: Longer default deadline on mobile; re-prepare automatically
frustrations.say: My transaction failed with DeadlineExpired.

frustrations.cause: BOR-011 checks HF >= 1.10 after the call; interest accrues between preview and inclusion, so a borrow sized to exactly 1.10 fails
frustrations.fix: App sizes "max" to 1.10 plus a margin (e.g. +0.5%), and the spec states that margin
frustrations.say: I pressed 'max' and the borrow reverted.

frustrations.cause: Slow network / low fee
frustrations.fix: Fee bumping and pending-tx status in the app
frustrations.say: My transaction never confirmed.

frustrations.cause: The app plan has no notification service (apps/README.md)
frustrations.fix: Opt-in health alerts (email/push/Telegram) at user-chosen HF levels via the indexer
frustrations.say: Nobody told me my position was at risk.

frustrations.cause: One PositionProxy per wallet per Spoke; worst-state rule over every collateral market (Q-081, Q-225, Q-234)
frustrations.fix: Allow several accounts per wallet (proxy index) so markets can be isolated; app shows which market blocks
frustrations.say: A problem in one of my markets blocked borrowing and withdrawing in all of them.

frustrations.cause: Pool-share cap applies to every pledge, including rescue top-ups (REQ-RISK-023, SPEC-CAP-005); in-range liquidity collapses in a depeg
frustrations.fix: Exempt top-ups of indebted accounts below 1.10 (up to the restore amount) from the pool-share test, as the slice already is from token/depositor caps
frustrations.say: My rescue top-up was refused because Avana holds too much of the pool.

frustrations.cause: One borrow nonce per proxy (Q-106)
frustrations.fix: Single pending borrow across tabs/devices (already planned); clear message
frustrations.say: My second borrow failed with BadNonce.

frustrations.cause: depositorUsdCap (Q-055) is per wallet and easy to bypass with more wallets
frustrations.fix: Either accept and document, or drop the per-depositor cap in favour of market/token caps
frustrations.say: I hit the per-depositor cap and had to split across wallets.

frustrations.cause: USD band uses uncapped prices (SPEC-ORC-011); GHO above ~$1.0404 breaches usdBandHigh 1.02 although REQ-ORACLE-009 says GHO markets stay Live above peg
frustrations.fix: Test the upper band on capped prices, or only on a common-mode move of both tokens
frustrations.say: Borrowing GHO stopped exactly when GHO traded above $1.

frustrations.cause: minPledgeUsd = $10 (Q-230)
frustrations.fix: Pre-check value before approval; state the minimum on the pledge screen
frustrations.say: My small position is below the $10 minimum.

frustrations.cause: Slice only while HF < 1.10 and only up to the restore amount (Q-157); pre-emptive top-ups at HF 1.10-1.3 need regular room
frustrations.fix: Allow slice top-ups up to a higher rescue target (e.g. HF 1.25) and show slice room
frustrations.say: My top-up was refused because the market is full, even though my account is getting weak.

frustrations.cause: Paused refuses top-ups (EMG-018, Q-227) while liquidation continues (LIQ-002)
frustrations.fix: Allow top-ups in Paused (they only add collateral) or make the pause reason explicit and pair it with a repay prompt
frustrations.say: I wanted to add collateral during the pause and couldn't, then I was liquidated.
